posts.zh:
dsh-mermaid-render 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Web UI 对话 mermaid 渲染插件：将消息中的 mermaid 代码块渲染为可交互图表卡片（缩放 / 适应宽度 / 全屏查看 / 预览代码切换），复用官方组件原语，渲染失败时保留原代码块并内联展示错误。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a5b3db984c310a6e6090.html
posts.en:
dsh-mermaid-render is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Mermaid diagram renderer for the Web UI conversation: renders mermaid code blocks into interactive cards (zoom, fit-width, fullscreen viewer, preview/code toggle) with official UI primitives, and keeps the original code block with an inline error banner when rendering fails.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a5b3db984c310a6e6090.html
